Hi Michael —

Hope you had a good weekend. We're ready to move forward on the 12‑month renewal you quoted (starting 2026‑06‑01) and want to add a capacity top‑up: +500k tokens/mo for chat workloads. A few operational items to confirm so procurement can raise the PO: 

- HedgeWave will consolidate billing under a single payor (HedgeWave, Inc) and route invoices to invoicing@hedgewave.com.
- We need to change net terms from Net30 to Net60 for this renewal period — is that something Redwood can authorize for this account on a standard renewal?
- Procurement needs your W‑9 (US entity) plus any EU VAT guidance if Redwood will issue invoices to our UK subsidiary later.
- Please confirm who to send the PO to and whether Redwood can accept nominal PO reference HW‑PO‑2026‑045.

If we can get the W‑9 and a short confirmation on Net60 and invoice routing by Wednesday we can get the PO out the door. Attaching the renewal SOW we discussed.

Thanks,
Sana Patel
Director, Procurement
HedgeWave

Hi Sana — thanks for the clear ask and for confirming the capacity numbers. Quick summary and next steps from our side:

2) PO: Yes — Redwood can accept PO reference HW‑PO‑2026‑045. Please have procurement include the PO number on the invoice PDF (invoice to invoicing@hedgewave.com, cc finance@hedgewave.com).
3) Tax docs: Attached is our current W‑9 (Redwood Inference, EIN redacted). For EU VAT guidance, Marissa can loop in the tax team — if the invoice is sent to a UK VAT‑registered entity we'll need the VAT registration number and billing entity name.
4) Billing contact: We'll update the billing contact to procurement@hedgewave.com once the PO is received and we have the invoicing email validated.

I've attached the W‑9 and the final quote (Quote‑RWI‑2489‑v3.pdf). Marissa/Stephanie — can you confirm the invoice cadence (monthly) and whether finance needs any additional ledger/GL fields from HedgeWave?

Onboarding timeline: once we have the signed PO and tax evidence we can start provisioning the additional capacity the week of 2026‑06‑01.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
